draft.title: The Torah and the Tanakh
card: Tanakh
the Hebrew Bible, the collection of sacred writings of Judaism. It has three parts: the Torah, the Prophets (Nevi'im) and the Writings (Ketuvim).
Torah
the first five books of the Tanakh: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers and Deuteronomy. The word Torah means teaching or instruction.
Talmud
a record of rabbinic teaching and discussion. It is a separate work from the Tanakh, and rabbis (Jewish teachers) use it to explain how to understand the Torah.
So the Torah is one part of the Tanakh. The Talmud is not part of the Tanakh. It comes from rabbis discussing the Torah and its meaning.
draft.remember: The Torah is the first part of the Tanakh. The Talmud is rabbinic discussion of it.

a.q: How is the Torah related to the Tanakh?
opts: The Torah is the first of the three parts of the Tanakh
The Torah is another name for the whole Tanakh
The Torah is a record of rabbis discussing the Tanakh
The Torah is the last of the three parts of the Tanakh
a.why: The Tanakh has three parts, and the Torah is the first, made up of five books. It is not the whole Tanakh, because the Prophets and the Writings are also in it.
a.clue: Think of the Tanakh as a whole and the Torah as one part.

b.q: Rabbi Dana's class studies a text in which rabbis over many years discuss how to apply a law in the Torah. Which text is this?
opts: The Talmud
The Torah
The Prophets
The Tanakh
b.why: The Talmud records rabbinic teaching and discussion about the Torah. The Torah is the text being discussed, not the record of the discussion. The Tanakh is the Hebrew Bible, which does not include the Talmud.
b.clue: Which text is a record of rabbis discussing, not the text they discuss?

a.best: The Torah is the first of the three parts of the Tanakh
